segments.an4.58:1.1: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an4.58:2.1: “Bhojanaṃ, gahapati, dadamāno ariyasāvako paṭiggāhakānaṃ cattāri ṭhānāni deti.
segments.an4.58:2.3: Āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti.
segments.an4.58:2.4: Āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
segments.an4.58:2.5: Vaṇṇaṃ datvā … sukhaṃ datvā … balaṃ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
segments.an4.58:2.6: Bhojanaṃ, gahapati, dadamāno ariyasāvako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhānāni detī”ti.
segments.an4.58:4.1: “So āyudāyī vaṇṇadāyī [so āyudāyī baladāyī (sī. pī.), āyudāyī baladāyī (syā. kaṃ.)], sukhaṃ balaṃ dado [sukhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ dado (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), sukhabaladado (ka.)] naro;

lines: Cattāri ṭhānāni anuppavecchatīti cattāri kāraṇāni anuppaveseti dadāti.
